limitations: Component roles are version-scoped protocol knowledge; deployment addresses and ABIs remain owned by the Contracts module.

records.name: MUSD
records.role: ERC-20 stablecoin whose supply can be minted or burned only by addresses on owner-managed role lists.

evidence.establishes: Token identity and role-gated supply control.
Published stablecoin purpose and component grouping.

records.name: BorrowerOperations
records.role: User-facing orchestration entrypoint for opening, adjusting, refinancing, closing, and collateral-claim operations on troves.

evidence.locator: Borrower Trove Operations; restricted operations; setAddresses
evidence.establishes: Current entrypoints and connected system components.
Published custody entrypoint and high-level position flow.

records.name: BorrowerOperationsSignatures
records.role: EIP-712 signature adapter that relays authorized borrower operations to BorrowerOperations while preserving the borrower identity in signed messages.

evidence.locator: EIP712Upgradeable inheritance; signed operation structs; restricted BorrowerOperations calls
evidence.establishes: Signature relay role and borrower/recipient separation.

evidence.locator: System Overview; Key Changes from THUSD
evidence.establishes: Published supporting-contract and EIP-712 role.

records.name: TroveManager
records.role: Canonical trove state manager; accounts for collateral, principal, interest, stake, status, redistribution rewards, liquidations, and redemptions.

evidence.establishes: State ownership and current system relationships.
Published core-protocol role.

records.name: StabilityPool
records.role: Accounts for deposited MUSD used to offset liquidated debt and for the corresponding collateral gains of depositors.

evidence.locator: state trackers; provideToSP; offset; collateral-gain accounting
evidence.establishes: Deposit, debt-offset, and collateral-gain role.
Published high-level liquidation-offset role.

records.name: ActivePool
records.role: Tracks native BTC collateral, principal, and interest assigned to active troves; it does not custody MUSD debt tokens for those troves.

evidence.establishes: Active-trove collateral and debt accounting role.
Published active-collateral custody flow.

records.name: DefaultPool
records.role: Tracks redistributed liquidation collateral and debt that belongs to active troves but has not yet been applied to their individual state.

evidence.establishes: Pending redistribution accounting role.
Published redistribution and aggregate-state role.

records.name: CollSurplusPool
records.role: Tracks native BTC collateral surplus claimable by a trove owner after protocol operations assign that surplus.

evidence.establishes: Per-account surplus accounting and claim path.
Published surplus terminology.

records.name: GasPool
records.role: Holds the MUSD gas-compensation reserve associated with troves and transfers compensation only when instructed by TroveManager.

evidence.establishes: Reserve custody and authorized transfer role; the stale numeric comment is excluded.
The reserve is represented as a debt component in the current implementation.

records.name: PriceFeed
records.role: Reads the configured external BTC/USD oracle, enforces its freshness bound, and normalizes the result to protocol price precision.

evidence.establishes: External-oracle binding, freshness check, and normalization role.
Published use of an external BTC/USD price oracle.

records.name: SortedTroves
records.role: Maintains a descending doubly linked list of active trove-owner addresses ordered by nominal collateral ratio.

evidence.establishes: Ordering key, direction, node identity, and mutation role.
Published role of hints and the sorted list in integration.

records.name: HintHelpers
records.role: Provides read-only approximate insertion and redemption-hint calculations for consumers of the sorted-trove structure.

evidence.establishes: Read-only helper role.
Published integration purpose for hints.

records.name: InterestRateManager
records.role: Owns the global rate offered to new/refinanced troves and accrues aggregate simple interest into ActivePool debt while minting the matching MUSD to PCV.

evidence.establishes: Global-rate ownership and aggregate accrual behavior.
Published fixed simple-interest model.

records.name: PCV
records.role: Receives protocol interest and fees, accounts for the bootstrap loan and protocol StabilityPool position, and distributes MUSD or BTC according to current governed recipients and splits.

evidence.locator: contract notice; initializeDebt; distributeMUSD; distributeBTC; StabilityPool functions
evidence.establishes: Current fee, bootstrap-loan, StabilityPool, and distribution responsibilities.

evidence.locator: Protocol Controlled Value; Protocol Bootstrap Loan
evidence.establishes: Published high-level PCV and bootstrap model; recipient wording is not promoted.

records.name: GovernableVariables
records.role: Owns council/treasury role bindings and the fee-exempt-account set consumed by BorrowerOperations.

evidence.establishes: Current governance-role and fee-exemption ownership.
BorrowerOperations consumption of this configuration.
